name: row_protocol_solves_of_injective
lines: ⊢ RowProtocolSolves S hS fun v => f (p v)
hview : rowViewOfSage hS π₁ x = rowViewOfSage hS π₂ x
hmulti : rowMultiset hS (fun v => f (p v)) π₁ = rowMultiset hS (fun v => f (p v)) π₂
⊢ rowMultiset hS p π₁ = rowMultiset hS p π₂
hmap : ∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin S)), rowMultiset hS (fun v => f (p v)) π = Multiset.map f (rowMultiset hS p π)
⊢ rowMultiset hS (fun v => f (p v)) π = Multiset.map f (rowMultiset hS p π)
⊢ Multiset.map (fun i => f (p (rowView hS π i))) Finset.univ.val =
Multiset.map f (Multiset.map (fun i => p (rowView hS π i)) Finset.univ.val)
Multiset.map (f ∘ fun i => p (rowView hS π i)) Finset.univ.val
⊢ Multiset.map f (rowMultiset hS p π₁) = Multiset.map f (rowMultiset hS p π₂)

steps.tactic: intro x π₁ π₂ hview hmulti
apply hp x π₁ π₂ hview

have hmap (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin S)) : rowMultiset hS (fun v => f (p v)) π = Multiset.map f (rowMultiset hS p π) :=
  by
  dsimp [rowMultiset]
  rw [Multiset.map_map]
  rfl
